task.description:
CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR Step 2b — review the design artefact before implementation begins.

This is a HARD GATE. Any failure = FAIL result.

Read the handoff file above in full before starting. Then:

1. Read src/design/uat-scenario-schema-v1.1-apply.md (the design under review).
2. Run python tools/lint_design_artefact.py src/design/uat-scenario-schema-v1.1-apply.md — must exit 0, no BLOCKER/MAJOR.
3. Verify the design covers ALL §7 consumers from docs/agents/uat-scenario-schema-v1.1-addendum.md:
   - UAT_RUNNER.md
   - PRODUCT_OWNER.md
   - ORCHESTRATOR.md (per §7's row)
   - WF-05_uat_run.md
   - WF-06_scenario_authoring.md
4. For each edit block in the design, verify it has: anchor location, before/after text, rationale.
5. Verify no implementation code (Zig/SQL) is present — this is a Type E prose design for a docs-only change.
6. Verify that the design preserves the hard constraints from the addendum:
   - via: system forbidden in uat_surface: gui workflows
   - evidence required on every system_state outcome
   - via: api remains forbidden
7. Verify the design does NOT touch the three BO-* docs (BO-SWIFTROUTE.md, BO-VORTEX.md, BO-MERIDIAN.md).

Return PASS if all 7 checks pass. Return FAIL with a structured issue list otherwise.
acceptance_criteria: python tools/lint_design_artefact.py src/design/uat-scenario-schema-v1.1-apply.md exits 0 with no BLOCKER/MAJOR
Each edit has anchor + before/after + rationale
Hard constraints from addendum §3 and §4 are preserved
Three BO-* docs are NOT touched
